systematic_read.airway_lungs: CURRENT: Trachea is central with the expected slight rightward deviation at the aortic arch. No central airway narrowing is seen at this resolution. Lung volumes are large. No focal consolidation, collapse or discrete mass in any zone. Mildly coarse markings in the right lower zone. Vascular markings reach the chest wall on both sides. PRIOR: Same appearance, with large lung volumes and mildly coarse right lower zone markings. A tiny density projects over the right medial upper zone near the anterior first rib end on the prior only (see cant_determine).
systematic_read.mediastinum_hila: CURRENT: Aortic knuckle is prominent, consistent with an unfolded aorta. Upper mediastinum is not widened. Right hilum is unremarkable. Left hilum is not bulky, and a small ring shadow consistent with an end-on bronchus is seen there. PRIOR: Aortic knuckle is similar. The left hilum looks denser and fuller than on the current. The prior has higher contrast and mild rotation, so this difference is indeterminate.
systematic_read.pleura: CURRENT: Both costophrenic angles are sharp. No pleural line and no visible pleural thickening. PRIOR: Both costophrenic angles are sharp. No pleural line. The left base is partly overlapped by gas-filled bowel under the left dome.
systematic_read.heart: CURRENT: Heart is not enlarged on this PA film, and its borders are defined. PRIOR: Heart is not enlarged, with a similar size and contour.
systematic_read.diaphragm_below: CURRENT: The left dome sits level with or slightly higher than the right, the reverse of the usual relationship. Gastric bubble lies under the left dome. No gas under the right dome. PRIOR: Same relationship of the domes. The stomach and splenic flexure under the left dome are more distended with gas. That gas has the configuration of bowel, and there is no gas under the right dome.
systematic_read.bones_soft_tissue: CURRENT: No displaced rib fracture or destructive rib lesion is seen at this resolution. Degenerative change at both shoulders and in the lower cervical spine. No soft tissue gas. PRIOR: Same appearance. Fine bone detail is limited on both images.
systematic_read.devices: CURRENT: A left-sided central venous catheter enters from the left lateral chest or axillary region and crosses the midline. Its tip projects over the right paramediastinal region at the expected level of the superior vena cava. The insertion site is not on the film. PRIOR: Same catheter with the same course and a similar tip position. No new device.

findings.description: Left hilar density is fuller and denser on the prior than on the current. The current left hilum is not bulky and shows an end-on bronchus.
findings.evidence: Both studies are PA. The prior shows a denser, more lobulated left hilar shadow, and the current shows a less conspicuous left hilum. The prior has higher contrast and mild rotation, and either might explain the difference.

findings.description: Left-sided central venous catheter with its tip projecting over the expected superior vena cava.
findings.evidence: The catheter course and tip position match on both studies. No new device is seen.

findings.description: Left dome is level with or slightly higher than the right, with gas-filled stomach and colon beneath it.
findings.evidence: The relative height of the domes matches on both studies. Gas distension under the left dome is less on the current. No gas is seen under the right dome on either study.

findings.description: Prominent aortic knuckle, consistent with an unfolded aorta. The upper mediastinum is not widened.
findings.evidence: The aortic knuckle contour and mediastinal width match on both PA studies.

findings.description: Mildly coarse lung markings in the right lower zone, with no focal consolidation.
findings.evidence: The pattern and extent are similar on both studies. Overlying soft tissue may contribute to the lower zone density.

cant_determine.question: Is the left hilum truly smaller on the current study than on the prior?
cant_determine.reason: The prior has higher contrast and mild rotation, and both can make one hilum look larger and denser. A frontal film alone does not separate vessel from node or mass.
cant_determine.recommend: CT chest with contrast, and review of the source images in PACS.

cant_determine.question: Is the tiny density over the right medial upper zone on the prior a lung nodule or first rib costochondral calcification?
cant_determine.reason: The density is well under the size at which X-ray separates a nodule from bone or a vessel end-on. It is not clearly seen on the lower-contrast current film.
cant_determine.recommend: Review the source images in PACS. CT chest if it persists on review.

cant_determine.question: Is there opacity behind the heart or at the left base?
cant_determine.reason: The relatively high left dome and gas-filled bowel overlap the left base and retrocardiac region on a frontal film alone.
cant_determine.recommend: Lateral view or CT chest.

cant_determine.question: Is there a focal bone lesion in the ribs, shoulders or spine?
cant_determine.reason: The images are low resolution and compressed, so fine bone detail is not assessable.
cant_determine.recommend: Review the source images in PACS.

differences.prevents: Fine comparison of basal lung markings and of small differences in heart size.

systematic_read.airway_lungs: CURRENT: Trachea central. Carina and main bronchi not narrowed as far as seen. Lungs are well expanded with large volumes. No focal consolidation, mass or lobar collapse. Mildly prominent bronchovascular markings at the right base. Vascular markings reach the chest wall on both sides. PRIOR: Trachea central. Large lung volumes. No focal consolidation, mass or collapse. Similar right basal markings. No convincing interval change in either lung.
systematic_read.mediastinum_hila: CURRENT: Prominent, unfolded aortic knuckle. Upper mediastinum not widened. Left hilum is fuller and denser than the right, with a small ring lucency projected over it that may be a bronchus seen end-on. Right hilum unremarkable. PRIOR: Prominent aortic knuckle of similar contour. Left hilum is fuller and denser than the right, to a similar degree given the higher contrast. Right hilum unremarkable.
systematic_read.pleura: CURRENT: Both costophrenic angles are sharp. No visible pleural line. No pleural thickening identified. PRIOR: Both costophrenic angles are sharp. No visible pleural line. No interval change.
systematic_read.heart: CURRENT: Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal for a PA film. Heart borders are sharp. PRIOR: Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal, similar. Heart borders are sharp.
systematic_read.diaphragm_below: CURRENT: Left dome sits at or slightly above the level of the right dome. Gastric bubble under the left dome. No free gas under the right dome. PRIOR: Same relationship of the domes. Marked gas distension of stomach and/or colon beneath the left dome, with several gas-filled loops. No free gas under the right dome. The subdiaphragmatic gas is less on the current study.
systematic_read.bones_soft_tissue: CURRENT: No definite destructive rib, clavicle or shoulder lesion at this resolution. Degenerative change in the visible spine. Breast soft-tissue shadows look asymmetric, with the right lower zone hazier than the left. No soft-tissue gas. PRIOR: Same bony appearance and the same right-greater-than-left lower zone haze. No soft-tissue gas.
systematic_read.devices: CURRENT: Left-sided central venous catheter enters the field from the left arm or axillary region, crosses the left upper chest and midline, and its tip projects over the expected region of the superior vena cava to the right of midline. No reservoir is seen within the field. PRIOR: Same catheter with the same course and a similar tip position. No new device.

findings.description: Left-sided central venous catheter entering from the left arm or axillary region, tip projecting over the expected superior vena cava to the right of midline. No reservoir within the field.
findings.evidence: Both studies show the same course across the left upper chest and a vertical distal segment right of midline, ending at a similar level.

findings.description: Left hilum is fuller and denser than the right on both studies. A small ring lucency projects over it on the current study, possibly a bronchus seen end-on.
findings.evidence: Left hilar contour and bulk are similar on both PA films. The prior looks denser, which the higher image contrast accounts for. The ring lucency is more conspicuous on the softer current film.

findings.description: Prominent, unfolded aortic knuckle. Upper mediastinum is not widened.
findings.evidence: Aortic knuckle contour and upper mediastinal width are the same on both PA films.

findings.description: Cardiac silhouette at the upper limit of normal for a PA film, with sharp borders.
findings.evidence: Same PA projection on both. The transverse heart width relative to the chest width is similar on both studies.

findings.description: Gas distension of stomach and/or colon beneath the left dome on the prior, with the left dome at or slightly above the right. Less gas on the current study. No free gas under the right dome on either study.
findings.evidence: Prior shows a large gas collection with several loops under the left dome. Current shows only a modest gastric bubble. The relationship of the two domes is unchanged.

findings.description: Mildly prominent bronchovascular markings at the right base, without focal consolidation.
findings.evidence: Similar pattern and extent on both studies. Some of the right lower zone haze may be overlying breast soft tissue.

cant_determine.question: Is the left hilar fullness vascular (pulmonary artery) or nodal?
cant_determine.reason: A frontal film alone cannot separate vessel from lymph node, and the difference in image contrast between the two studies limits judgment of subtle density change.
cant_determine.recommend: Correlate with any previous cross-sectional imaging. If none is available, contrast-enhanced CT chest.

cant_determine.question: Is the small ring lucency over the left hilum on the current study a bronchus seen end-on or a small cavitary or cystic focus?
cant_determine.reason: The structure is small, overlaps hilar vessels, and is seen on a downsampled frontal image only. It is less conspicuous on the higher-contrast prior.
cant_determine.recommend: Review the source image in PACS. Lateral view or CT chest if it persists.

cant_determine.question: Does the asymmetry of the breast shadows reflect previous left breast surgery, or positioning?
cant_determine.reason: Soft-tissue contours are partly outside the field and faint at this resolution. The asymmetry makes the right lower zone look hazier than the left on both studies.
cant_determine.recommend: Correlate with surgical history. Do not read the right lower zone haze as lung opacity without that correlation.

cant_determine.question: What is the exact catheter tip position relative to the cavoatrial junction, and what type of line is it?
cant_determine.reason: The carina and the right atrial junction are not sharply defined on these images, and the insertion site and any reservoir lie outside the field.
cant_determine.recommend: Review the source image in PACS with windowing. Correlate with the line insertion record.

cant_determine.question: Are there small nodules in the retrocardiac region, at the apices or behind the diaphragm domes?
cant_determine.reason: Only a single frontal view of each study is available. These areas are hidden by overlap, and small nodules cannot be separated from vessels seen end-on or from rib ends.
cant_determine.recommend: Lateral view, or CT chest if there is clinical concern.

cant_determine.question: Is there a subtle rib, spine or shoulder lesion?
cant_determine.reason: The images are low resolution and compressed, and fine bone detail such as cortex, pedicles and small lucent lesions is not reliably shown.
cant_determine.recommend: Review the source images in PACS on bone settings.
